correctness.rationale: Used original RESULT.md and exact verify.py/certificate.json, reconstructed all rook faces sizes 1..5: (25,200,600,600,120). From α(0;0,1)∧α(1;2,3)∧β(2,3;4), independently built 8-term Z and transposed signed 8-term cycle. Independently parsed the actual 60-term mod-3 chain W and 184-term cocycle φ; checked ∂W=Z+τZ exactly mod3, δφ=0 on all 600 four-rook faces, <φ,Z>=1, and pairings with τZ, transposed row01 and col01 are all 2 mod3. Independently computed exact F3 ranks ∂2=176 and ∂3=423, giving H2(F3) one-dimensional, proving τ acts −1 on the unique Z/3 via UCT and known H1=0. Each four-rook face belongs to uniquely one five-rook face, giving unit minor and free integral H3; reduced Euler −56 then rank56, given cited prior integral homology and connectivity. For transpose, signed fixed-face Lefschetz recurrence F5=0 yields trace zero and 28 +1 eigenrank; coinvariants over Z_(3) are exact since 2 invertible. Simply connected X and a fixed diagonal vertex yield π1 quotient=0 via Armstrong. Localized H3 only free rank28 implies a 3-local wedge of 28 S3 by Hurewicz/Whitehead. Does NOT assert integral wedge or no 2-primary torsion. Full rank/cocycle checks independently reimplemented, not trusted solely to log.

originality.rationale: Shareshian–Wachs explicitly supplies the Z/3 class and side-preserving sign characters. Jonsson supplies an independent computer-free proof of the same torsion group. Those results do not supply transpose action, which is a nontrivial extension of the side-group sign character, or the ordinary orbit-space localized topology. A new concrete mod-3 boundary certificate determines it. The prior ordinary Betti and rational representation theory also cannot by itself fix torsion transposition.
